1.

The statement of the victim under section 164 Cr.P.C., produced by the learned Aga, is taken on
record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Anupam Anand, learned Brief Holder for the State and perused the material placed on record.
3.

This application under section 438 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.311 of 2023 (Case No. 1002/9 of 2024), under sections 498A, 452, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C., and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Kotwali Sambhal, District Sambhal.

sentences.text: Counsel for the applicants submits that the applicants have been falsely implicated in the instant case.

The applicant no.1 is father-in-law, the applicant nos. 2, 3 and 5 are Nanad, the applicant no.4 is mother-in-law, the applicant no.6 is the Nandoi of the victim/opposite party no.2 and the applicant no.7 is family friend of applicant no.1.
Vague and general allegations have been levelled against the applicants.
In the alleged incident the opposite party no.2/victim has not sustained any injury.
Charge-sheet has been filed against the applicants.
The applicants have cooperated in the investigation.
The applicants have no criminal history.
The applicants have apprehension of their arrest in the above mentioned case.
5. Learned Brief Holder for the State opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid submissions from the record.

6. Having regard to the submissions made by learned counsel for the applicants, considering the nature of accusations and antecedents of the applicants and in particular the fact that the vague and general allegations have been levelled against the applicants, the fact that the opposite party no.2/victim has not received any injury, the fact that the applicants have co-operated in the investigation, without commenting on merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicants are entitled to be enlarged on anticipatory bail.
8. In default of any of the conditions, the court concerned is at liberty to pass appropriate orders for enforcing and compelling the same.
9. The application stands disposed of.

Order Date :- 10.9.2024 S.S.
